title: Chapter 244
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

The sound of an explosion came from not far away. Hella tensed up. She knew that Han Xiao had started to attract attention.

A large group of pursuers ran in the direction of the explosion. The leader was an executive officer. When he saw Hella, he frowned and said, "You're going in the wrong direction. The enemy is behind you."

"I have another mission."

Hella put on her cold disguise again, pushed through the crowd, and hurriedly left.

Along the way, she encountered more than ten groups of pursuers. Hella did not dare to stop. Fortunately, everyone only looked at her curiously and did not question her. They hurriedly passed by her.

The incident happened so suddenly that Hella's betrayal had not been exposed. Even with her strong heart, she could not help but secretly feel lucky that Han Xiao had reacted in time and destroyed all the cameras, creating an advantageous situation.

Only when it involved her sister would Hella's indifferent state of mind be affected.

The journey to the target floor was smooth. All the members were rushing upstairs to stop Zero. There was no one around. Hella started to destroy the cameras along the way to prevent the exact location of the secret passage from being discovered. When the Germinal Organization came back to their senses, they would definitely realize that Aurora had disappeared.

After completing all this, Hella opened the secret door and entered the hidden passage. This was a dark and narrow passage that only allowed people to move forward while squatting.

After closing the secret door of the passage, all sound was isolated. Silence was pervasive like the air. The nervousness was also expelled, leaving only the sound of gradually slowing heartbeat.

It was only now that Hila could finally heave a sigh of relief and relax.

Entering the passage, the escape plan was more than half successful.

Hella opened the zipper of the backpack. Aurora poked her head out and looked around curiously. "Did we escape?"

"Almost." Hella patted Aurora's head lovingly.

Aurora obediently rubbed the back of her hand and hid her face in the backpack, only revealing a pair of big watery eyes. Suddenly, she asked, "Where's Uncle Zero?"

Hella paused for a moment. "At most five minutes. He should be … here soon."

Aurora tilted her head. "Sister, Uncle Zero seems to be very strong."

"He's okay," Hella said vaguely.

"Sister, why did he come to save me?"

"How would I know?" Hella said, but her hand could not help but touch the photo hidden in her pocket. She remembered that when she was still at the base, 0 had seen this photo. could it be at that time …

However, at that time, Zero was too busy to take care of himself. Why did he remember such a trivial matter? With just one look at the photo, he planned today's operation. Could it be that his' foresight 'ability allowed him to see the future?

Hella shook her head. She still could not figure out Han Xiao's motive. She only felt that the figure was as elusive as a cloud of fog. The current situation of the Germinal Organization was almost all caused by him. She was very afraid of such a person.

She remembered that when they were at the base, 0 was still her apprentice. He was so weak that she could easily crush him. But now, in such a short time, he had become a person that even she was afraid of. Life was unpredictable. Hella was expressionless, but she sighed in her heart.

"Sister, Uncle Zero, he …"

"Don't always mention him." Hella was a little impatient. Although Han Xiao had saved her sister, for some reason, she could not connect the 0 who was trained at the base with the current Han Xiao. She always felt that something was missing. There was an inexplicable sense of familiarity, as if she had seen him somewhere before, but she could not remember.

Aurora said in a wronged tone, "Sister, when you were telling me stories, you clearly admired him …"

"Nonsense." Hella pinched Aurora's face.

At this time, a third person's voice sounded in the dark and narrow space.

"Did I hear wrongly? You actually admire me?"

Hila immediately turned around, and just as she was about to use her Esper ability, she felt an iron-like hand grab her wrist and press her against the wall.

With the help of the dark red light, she saw the sudden appearance of the third person. It was Han Xiao, who was supposed to attract the firepower outside.

"Why are you here?" Hila's heart trembled.

Han Xiao let go of his hand and laughed. "I am everywhere."

Hella's body softened, and she dispersed her ability. She remembered very clearly that she had only opened the passage once and had not opened it again. How did Han Xiao come in? Through the wall?

Han Xiao smiled but did not say anything. When he took the initiative to suggest splitting up, he already had a simple but effective plan. Of course, he would not bet on whether Hella would tell him the real location, so he had left two tricks up his sleeve. One was a simple tracker on Aurora's bag, and the second was a trump card that he had never used before. It was the Dion Character Summon Card that he had obtained in the Western Continent, which had a special effect of invisibility.

Although he was very strong, he did not want to be surrounded. His main mission was to escape from the headquarters. Therefore, after killing No. 1, Han Xiao walked forward and destroyed all the cameras at the intersection, giving the Germinal Organization the illusion that he was in that area. He then activated Dion's Character Summon Card, turned back, and secretly followed Hella.

Whether Hella was telling the truth or not, she was definitely using the real secret passage.

Dion's Character Summon Card's ability was called "You Can't See Me". Han Xiao swaggered past, and the soldiers completely ignored him.
